name: Sceva's Sons (Exorcists)
title: The Failed Exorcists
summary: Sceva's sons were seven Jewish exorcists who attempted to cast out evil spirits by using Jesus' name without having personal faith in him. They were overpowered and injured by a demon-possessed man, which led many in Ephesus to turn to the Lord in awe.

keyEvents.title: Attempted Exorcism in Jesus' Name
keyEvents.description: Sceva's seven sons tried to cast out evil spirits by invoking the name of Jesus, whom Paul preached, without themselves having faith in Jesus.

keyEvents.title: The Evil Spirit's Reply
keyEvents.description: The evil spirit answered them by saying that it knew Jesus and was aware of Paul, but asked who they were - exposing their lack of spiritual authority.

keyEvents.title: Overpowered by the Possessed Man
keyEvents.description: The man with the evil spirit lunged at them, overpowered all of them, and injured them so severely that they fled naked and wounded from the house.

keyEvents.title: The Impact of the Event in Ephesus
keyEvents.description: News of what had happened spread among Jews and Greeks in Ephesus, and everyone was filled with fear. The name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.

keyEvents.title: Many Come to Faith
keyEvents.description: As a result of this event, many believers came forward and openly confessed what they had done, and many burned their magic books.
